Biographie

Marty Corrado is the Director of Industrialized Construction for Boldt Construction located in Appleton WI. Marty has a long history of mega healthcare construction across the US including the Miami Valley Hospital project in Dayton OH, University Medical Center in New Orleans and as the operations manager for the B2/Atlantic Yards in NYC, billed as the “world’s largest modular condo.” Marty has spent over 3 decades passionately committed to prefabrication, modularization, Lean and innovation in numerous states on projects he has managed. Marty is also the author of Prefabrication and the Re-Evolution of Construction
Prefab Potential delves into the latest advancements in offsite construction techniques, showcasing innovative practices that enhance efficiency, reduce waste, and improve project timelines. Industry expert, Marty Corrado will share real-world case studies, highlighting the benefits and challenges of integrating prefabrication into various types of projects.
